tess: Heads-up — onboarding sample (go/python) shows bad retry behavior: treating 4xx as transient and re-running auth refresh.
omar: snippet?
tess: sampleapp/go/client.go uses `if status >= 400 && status < 500 { retry() }` so 401/403 handled the same.
mira: intended mapping: 401 => AuthError (refresh once), 403 => PermissionDenied (do not refresh). Looks like a Go SDK parity bug.
ci-bot: CI: retry-matrix failing (see https://ci.example.com/5002).
qa-bot: Filed RW-3480: "Go SDK: correct 4xx mapping; update onboarding sample READMEs".
omar: I'll update MapHTTPStatusToError: set retry_hint="refresh" for 401, retry_hint="none" for 403, keep 429/5xx as backoff. Will add unit + integration tests simulating stale tokens vs permission errors. Branch `fix/go-4xx-map`.
tess: Also updating onboarding README to show an idiomatic snippet: `if IsAuthError(err) { refresh(); retryOnce() } else if IsRetryable(err) { backoffRetry() } else { surfaceToUser() }`. Add comment: do not auto-refresh on 403.
mira: Long-term proposal: standardize error envelope across SDKs with fields `code`, `message`, `http_status`, `retry_hint`, `recovery_hint` so apps don't rely on status-only heuristics.
qa-bot: After PR merge CI will run `retry-matrix` and `sample-app-smoke`. Link the sample commit in the docs PR.
tess: Thanks — let's get the fixes out quick to reduce token-refresh storms in demos/support. :thumbsup:
